description: This file defines the MedicalAgent class, which uses a mock vector store to provide guideline-based medical recommendations with safety warnings and heuristic medicine suggestions based on user queries.

classes.name: MedicalAgent
classes.description: A class implementing a simple rule-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system to produce health recommendations from guidelines, with additional heuristic medicine suggestions and safety disclaimers.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the MedicalAgent by loading the guideline vector store.

methods.name: List[str] _medicine_suggestions(self, user_query: str)
methods.description: Generates heuristic medicine/support recommendations based on keyword detection within the user query.

methods.name: List[str] _dedupe_preserve_order(self, items: List[str])
methods.description: Removes duplicate strings from a list while maintaining their original order.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
methods.description: Main public method that retrieves relevant guideline snippets, appends safety disclaimers, and heuristically suggests medicines based on the user query.

ctags.name: recommend
ctags.pattern: /^    def recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True) -> List[str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
